Sources.Description: Eventbrite's official API v3 reference, published as an Apiary API Blueprint (MSON format). This is the vendor's own machine-readable contract for the entire v3 surface: 32 resource groups, 102 documented operations (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE with real paths), and 223 MSON Data Structure type definitions (request/response schemas). It is the credential-free ground truth the connector's IO/IOF catalog, per-operation CRUD columns, and pagination shape (cursor `continuation` token) are derived from. Fetched RAW via curl and saved whole to sources/eventbrite-v3-api-blueprint.apib (394,417 bytes, 6,932 lines) -- this is the artifact the extractor script parses, never a WebFetch summary.
Sources.AccessNotes: Discovered via web search for 'Eventbrite API v3 · Apiary'. Confirmed identical byte-for-byte whether fetched from /reference.apib or /reference.apib (single canonical asset). This is the SAME content that backs the public-facing https://www.eventbrite.com/platform/api SPA (which is JS-rendered via window.__SERVER_DATA__ / client-side React Query fetch and does not expose its content to static curl/WebFetch -- the Apiary blueprint is the reachable machine-readable equivalent). Saved to sources/eventbrite-v3-api-blueprint.apib.

Sources.Description: Eventbrite Platform API landing/reference page (vendor-owned, canonical URL). This is a React SPA -- static curl/WebFetch retrieves only the page shell (nav chrome, no endpoint content); the actual reference content is client-fetched at runtime. The content is understood to mirror the Apiary API Blueprint (same vendor, same v3 surface) but could not be independently verified byte-for-byte via static fetch. Ranked Tier 1 for authority (canonical vendor URL) but the Apiary blueprint is used as the operative machine-readable artifact since it is provably complete.
Sources.AccessNotes: curl returned HTTP 200 but body is a JS shell with no endpoint content (confirmed via grep of window.__SERVER_DATA__ -- contains only page metadata, no reference.apib). WebFetch equally returned only the page title with no body. Retried via curl 2x, consistent JS-shell result both times. Not used as the parse source; the Apiary blueprint (identical vendor content, machine-readable) is used instead. Kept in SOURCES for citation/authority purposes only.

Sources.Description: Intro to APIs guide (vendor-owned). Same SPA rendering limitation as the main API reference page -- prose/tutorial content, not authoritative for object/field enumeration.
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200, JS shell only (same SPA pattern as /platform/api). Content is guide-level prose duplicating what the Apiary blueprint's '## About our API' / '## Authentication' sections state in machine-readable form. Not used for extraction; cited for provenance/context only.

Sources.Description: API Basics guide (vendor-owned) -- request/response conventions, auth, rate limits in prose form.
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200, JS shell only. Superseded for extraction purposes by the Apiary blueprint's equivalent machine-readable sections (## Authentication, ## Errors).

Sources.Description: Getting Information on Events guide (vendor-owned) -- tutorial walkthrough of the Events endpoints with worked curl examples.
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200, JS shell only. Tier 2 (guide/tutorial, not primary reference).

Sources.Description: Creating an Event guide (vendor-owned) -- write-path tutorial for POST /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.
Finding Order Information guide (vendor-owned) -- tutorial on Order retrieval/lookup patterns.
Working With Ticket Classes and Ticket Groups guide (vendor-owned).

Using Webhooks guide (vendor-owned) -- explains the webhook `actions` trigger vocabulary (event.created, order.placed, attendee.updated, etc.) in narrative form; the same enum is captured machine-readably in the Apiary blueprint's Webhook/Create Webhook MSON definitions.
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200, JS shell only. Tier 2 (guide). The authoritative trigger-action enum was extracted from the Apiary blueprint (line ~5696-5711), not this page.

Sources.Description: API Changelog (vendor-owned) -- deprecation notices. The Apiary blueprint cross-references this page inline for several deprecated endpoints (legacy /webhooks/ POST/GET, Event Search /events/search/).
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200, JS shell only. Not used for extraction; deprecation warnings were captured directly from inline blueprint annotations instead (each deprecated endpoint carries its own '> Warning:' block with an effective date).

Sources.Description: Community-published Postman collection for the Eventbrite API on the Postman API Network (OAuth 2.0 authorization configured; includes event retrieval and other v3 endpoints). NOT vendor-published/official -- it is a third-party documentation entry on Postman's public network. Useful as a secondary cross-check for endpoint shapes and a token-free way for downstream agents to browse request/response examples, but not treated as authoritative for hard constraints (PK/FK/required flags) given its non-vendor origin.
Sources.AccessNotes: HTTP 200. Confirmed reachable via curl. Not downloaded as a raw collection JSON (the page requires interactive Postman Network navigation to export collection.json; the documentation view itself is sufficient for secondary cross-referencing). Community/Tier-2 -- do not use for hard-constraint provenance; the Apiary API Blueprint is the Tier-1 machine-readable source of record.
